summary: The patch changes PasswordObfuscator.obfuscate to CQL-escape the password (doubling single quotes) and wrap it in Pattern.quote(). It also adds unit tests and a CHANGES.txt entry. The method is a stateless static function over its arguments. It has no shared mutable state, locks, executors, resources or lifecycle steps. I applied the checklist file refdir/.claude/skills/shallow-review/references/general/specialists/concurrency.md (all 24 items). None apply to the changed code. The new tests use only local objects. Nothing was left unreviewed (the patch is small and I read all of it). Non-concurrency correctness questions, such as whether the replacement string handles every case, belong to other lenses.
